reason: The three first-review findings and required consumer repairs are resolved locally. Prepared for final whole-batch review; this is not independent acceptance.

findings.reason: Added a deterministic finite supertriangle search, exact triangle-scan location with face and edge cases, and a reusable update interface that accepts the DAG's located certificate without rescanning.
Replaced the radius comparison with direct squared-distance bounds, showing each supertriangle vertex has squared distance greater than the circle's squared radius.
Added a finite-polynomial specialization argument choosing one positive real ε that preserves all relevant support signs, then maps output tetrahedra to distinct facets of a real 4-polytope.

consumer_checks.reason: Proof now establishes termination of the finite locator and verifies both face-split and interior-edge-split cases.
Passes its located face certificate to INSERT and updates the DAG from the returned replacement events.
Counts the constant number of certificate-validation predicates per insertion and confirms there is no additional triangle scan.
Its batch call remains compatible through the stable-identifier insertion-order default.
Its planar triangulation guarantee remains unchanged.
Its tie and output claims do not depend on the locator implementation.
Its direct lower-dimensional branch is unchanged.
Its returned-cell and interpolation claims are unchanged.
The page summary remains accurate with the finite locator and DAG-supplied location.
Its examples rely on unchanged companion-page output claims.
